dish.title: Mexican Rajas con Crema Tacos with Corn and Queso Fresco
dish.description: Blistered poblano strips cooked with onion, garlic, and corn kernels in Mexican crema with oregano, spooned into warm corn tortillas and finished with crumbled queso fresco, cilantro, and lime.

recipe_version.title: Mexican Rajas con Crema Tacos with Corn and Queso Fresco
recipe_version.description: Blistered poblano strips cooked with onion, garlic, and corn kernels in Mexican crema with oregano, spooned into warm corn tortillas and finished with crumbled queso fresco, cilantro, and lime.

ingredients.name: corn tortillas
ingredients.display_name: 6-inch corn tortillas whose label lists ground corn treated with lime and water

ingredients.name: queso fresco
ingredients.display_name: queso fresco made with microbial enzymes or vegetable rennet (no animal rennet on the label)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Slice the onion, mince the garlic, crumble the queso fresco, chop the cilantro, and cut the lime into wedges.

steps.title: Char the poblanos
steps.body: Preheat the broiler on high with a rack 4 inches below, about 5 minutes. Line the sheet pan with foil, lay the poblanos on it, and broil, turning with tongs every 3 minutes, until blackened all over, about 10 minutes.

steps.title: Steam and peel
steps.body: Put the poblanos in the bowl and cover with a plate for 10 minutes to loosen the skins. Rub off the blackened skins, pull out the stems and seeds, and cut the poblanos into strips 1/2 inch wide, about 6 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the rajas
steps.body: Heat the oil in the 12-inch skillet over medium, about 1 minute. Cook the onion until soft and golden at the edges, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic for 1 minute, the corn for 3 minutes, then the poblano strips, oregano, and salt for 2 minutes. Stir in the crema and simmer until it lightly coats, about 2 minutes.

steps.title: Warm the tortillas
steps.body: While the rajas cook (overlap stated): warm the tortillas 2 at a time in the dry 10-inch skillet over medium-high, about 30 seconds per side, and stack them in the towel.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fill the tortillas with rajas and top with queso fresco and cilantro. Serve with lime wedges.

equipment: medium bowl and a plate to cover it
